# Overtime Marketing (OTM)

> Full-campaign marketing agency based in Vancouver, BC, serving businesses across Canada and the United States. OTM builds fixed-price marketing campaigns around a single objective rather than disconnected monthly services.

## About
Overtime Marketing (OTM) is a productized campaign marketing agency founded by Taimoor Syed and Josh Bruneski. OTM has served 90+ brands and delivered 50+ campaigns with 30+ five-star client reviews. OTM uses a proprietary AI-powered operating system for video editing, image generation, onboarding, and reporting.

## Campaign Types & Pricing
- Brand Awareness Campaign — from $3,499 CAD
- Event Campaign — from $3,499 CAD
- Launch Campaign — from $4,999 CAD
- Rebrand Campaign — from $4,999 CAD
- Growth Campaign — from $7,499 CAD

## Services
Video & Photo Production, Digital Marketing, Branding & Design, Strategy — see /services
